Reference / runtime/system

runtime/system#

The native layer under fs/path, locale/system, os/platform, os/storage: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under fs/path, locale/system, os/platform, os/storage: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native system_platform#

native system_platform() is string

Portable platform identity and operating-system entropy boundary.

native system_architecture#

native system_architecture() is string

The machine architecture, such as x86_64 or aarch64.

native system_byte_order#

native system_byte_order() is string

little or big.

native system_host_name#

native system_host_name() is string

The host name.

native system_cpu_count#

native system_cpu_count() is int

How many processors.

native secure_random#

native secure_random(size is int) is @byte

size bytes from the system's secure random source.

native secure_integer#

native secure_integer(start is int, stop is int) is int

An unbiased integer in start..stop (start < stop): a sample of as many 64-bit words as stop - start - 1 needs is drawn again while it falls below 2^(64 * words) mod (stop - start).

native secure_float#

native secure_float() is float

53 random bits as a float in [0, 1).

native storage_usage#

native storage_usage(path is string) is %string:string

One coherent provider observation. Decimal strings avoid narrowing storage capacities to the builtin runtime int width.
